_meta.name: patientfusion-yafa-export-records
_meta.description: Navigate PatientFusion patient portal (used by Yafa Health LLC), export appointments, visit notes, prescriptions, and CCDA health summary.
_meta.provider: Haitham Serhan, PMHNP, AGNP — Yafa Health LLC, Ipswich MA
_meta.authStrategy: Email + password. Account email: mw@mike-wolf.com. Created Aug 2025 via noreply@patientfusion.com welcome email.
anomalies: PatientFusion is a legacy Allscripts product (now Veradigm) — UI is older, not a SPA
Portal may have limited export options compared to modern MyChart
Multiple reminder systems layered (Office Ally, Updox) — those are NOT portals, just appointment reminder services
Doxy.me links for video visits are one-time URLs, not stored in portal

chain.note: PatientFusion main portal landing. May redirect to login page.
Check for login form. If present, halt and prompt Mike to authenticate. Resume at s3.
Capture portal navigation: expect sections like Summary, Health Record, Appointments, Messages, Test Results.
Navigate to health record / summary section.
Capture available health record sections: Problems, Medications, Allergies, Immunizations, Vitals.
Trigger CCDA or health record download. PatientFusion supports CCDA export from the health record section.
Capture past and upcoming appointments: date, provider, type. Expected: ~quarterly appointments with Haitham Serhan.
Navigate to test results if available.
Capture any lab or test results. Yafa Health is psychiatry — may be limited.
Navigate to secure messages — clinical notes and care team communications are often here.
Capture message threads. These contain medication instructions, follow-up notes from Haitham Serhan.

auth-sentinel.note: PatientFusion is older HTML — IDs and class names are more stable than SPA. Perceive on first run to confirm.

ccda-download-link.note: Location varies by PatientFusion version. Also look for 'Download' text in health record section.

appointment-row.note: Unverified. Use perceive appointments and inspect structure.
